entries.name: G36C
entries.description: A select-fire rifle. The fire mode key switches between automatic, burst and semi-automatic.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Glock17
entries.description: The simplest kind of weapon: a model and a handful of numbers. Everything not written here comes from the global config and the framework defaults.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: M203
entries.description: A grenade launcher. The round is a physical projectile: it leaves slowly, arcs under gravity and explodes on the first thing it touches.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Remington700
entries.description: A bolt-action rifle with the realism options on: the chambered round is tracked separately from the magazine, and every shot needs the bolt cycled before the next.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Remington870
entries.description: A pump-action shotgun: several pellets per shell, a pump between shots, and shells loaded one at a time. Firing interrupts the reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Arcade
entries.description: Point and click. No reserve to manage, generous accuracy, gentle recoil, quick reloads and nothing to learn beyond aim, shoot and reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Realistic
entries.description: Everything on. The chamber is tracked, bolts and pumps are worked by hand, a dropped magazine takes its rounds with it, weapons can jam, and there is no crosshair or hitmarker to lean on. Hits are lethal.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Standard
entries.description: The framework defaults, unchanged. This preset exists so "the defaults" is something you can pick by name and copy as a starting point for your own.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Tactical
entries.description: Slower and more deliberate. Hip fire is loose, aimed fire is rewarded, recoil has to be controlled, and an early reload keeps the round in the chamber.
entries.author: xerseer
